name: Mozaic
rootCause: The DeFi project Mozaic was exploited, who stole approximately $2 million from the project. According to Mozaic, this individual was a Mozaic developer who had illegally obtained the private keys of a security module by compromising the data of a core team member. They also stated that about 90% of the stolen funds have now been frozen on MEXC.

descriptions.text: The DeFi project Mozaic was exploited, who stole approximately $2 million from the project. According to Mozaic, this individual was a Mozaic developer who had illegally obtained the private keys of a security module by compromising the data of a core team member. They also stated that about 90% of the stolen funds have now been frozen on MEXC.

On March 15, 2024, Mozaic, an Arbitrum-based protocol, suffered a major compromise due to private key theft, enabling the attacker to drain vaults and transfer approximately $2.4 million in assets to centralized exchanges. Some funds were reportedly frozen following incident response. A private key associated with Mozaic's vault management contract or security module was stolen, allowing the attacker to access and transfer user assets without restriction.
